name: GalaxyCon Richmond
blurb: A four-day Richmond festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers, cosplayers and tattoo artists.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON RICHMOND ... MARCH 18-21, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you again March 18-21, 2027 at the Greater Richmond Convention Center'

notes: Guest cards show only name + attendance days, no bio text, so Known for is left blank throughout. Cancellations live on a separate page (galaxycon-richmond-guest-cancellations) linked from this one, not mixed into the guest grid, so (unlike galaxycon-raleigh) nothing here was excluded as cancelled. One Authentication card (JSA / 'Official Authentication & Grading Services') is a vendor service, not an individual guest, and is excluded. Cover uses the Richmond wordmark logo for the same reason as galaxycon-raleigh: the shared og/hero images are generic multi-city or decorative assets, not edition-specific key art. Verify pass (2026-10-05): trimmed 44 -> 13 -- a fresh fetch shows each card's own (untruncated) image filename is itself year-tagged ('2027-GC-StephenAmell-Web-Program_Guide...' etc.), which also resolves the earlier truncated-alt mix-up: #10 Zach Aguilar and #11 Bill Farmer are tagged 2027-GC but literally share one image (Farmer's own photo isn't up yet), and #12 Bret Iwan / #13 Christopher Sabat share one duplicated 2025-GC image -- two editions stale -- so those two are dropped; every card from #15 Tom DeFalco onward (Featured Creators, Literary, Entertainment, Cosplay, Wrestlers, and the trailing Dana Snyder/Callum Kerr/Keith David/Michael Rooker) is uniformly tagged 2026-GC, i.e. carried over from the show that already ran in Richmond, and is dropped; only the 13 cleanly 2027-GC-tagged guests are kept. Refute pass (2026-10-05): upheld -- fresh re-extract confirms all 13 kept picks are still alt-tagged '2027-GC' (vs. '2025-GC'/'2026-GC' for the excluded cards, unchanged); the guest-cancellations page now 404s, so there is nothing to cross-check there. Refresh 2026-10-07: added Susanne Blakeslee, a new card on the GalaxyCon Richmond guest page whose image is tagged 2027-GC.
